definition: rain accumulated from t - 12 h to t + 12 h (12 h already fallen + 12 h forecast), where t is the prediction time, at the wettest 0.1 degree cell of the zone (predict.py takes the max of the column over the zone's segments)

validation.method: leave-one-event-out over 13 Copernicus EMS flash floods (28 zones); threshold = highest value catching 90 % of the other events' flood zones
validation.flood_zones_caught: 25/28 (missed: western Attica 2019 x2 at 28-30 mm, one Sicily 2021 zone at 43.9 mm)
validation.dry_spells_triggered: 5/126 wet spells without a Copernicus activation in the 120 days before each flood; at least one (Heraklion, 20 Oct 2020) is a documented but unmapped flood

tunisian_gauges_exploratory.status: exploratory; not an operational validation; threshold not refitted
tunisian_gauges_exploratory.data: 8 INM synoptic gauges (WMO SYNOP via NOAA ISD), 2014-09-01 to 2025-08-31, rebuilt on a 3-hour grid partly from 6-24 h totals; floods from press reports
tunisian_gauges_exploratory.floods_caught_event_station: 6/11 = 54.5 % (Wilson 95 %: 28-79 %); zones sharing a gauge on the same day count once
tunisian_gauges_exploratory.triggers_without_listed_flood: 135 zone-episodes; 74 station-episodes; 50 groups of time-overlapping station-episodes (not confirmed storms)
tunisian_gauges_exploratory.manual_review_of_25_flagged_station_epis: 12 possible unlisted floods, 7 unreliable rain data, 6 unresolved, 0 confirmed false alarms; review categories, not ground truth; no rain value changed

tunisian_imerg_exploratory.floods_caught_zone_dates: 5/14 with IMERG Final rain on the same floods

limits: fitted on IMERG Final; IMERG Early, radar or INM gauges give different values: re-check on Tunisian gauge records before production
dry spells are 'no mapped flood', not 'no flood'
Tunisian checks: incomplete press-based flood list, few gauges (1-20 km from each zone), rain partly reconstructed from 6-24 h totals, manual review decisions
gauge and IMERG differ in both directions (gauge 3-4x higher on intense urban storms): an IMERG-fitted threshold cannot be rescaled for gauges
calibration_window: calendar days 00-24 UTC (IMERG Final daily). A calendar day is one of the 24 h windows, so the operational rolling window is always >= it. Measured on the 28 flood storms (reports/med_trigger/window_check.csv): median x1.03, up to x1.7 when a storm straddles midnight; flood zones reaching 44 mm go from 24 to 27/28. False triggers will rise too, by an amount the daily data cannot measure: check on Tunisian gauge records before production.
